intent: Freeze the client brief, source assets, output contract, and review checks for this run.

rationale_summary.decision: Use the V7 task contract without silently changing its output requirements.
rationale_summary.why: The benchmark requires an auditable source-to-output record.
tradeoffs: The local layout exception changes the run from connector-only to hybrid.
alternatives_considered: Adobe Express alone cannot place the supplied source photos.
rationale_summary.uncertainty: Creative quality and connector behavior remain untested.

input_state.state_summary: 15 input assets and 12 required outputs registered.

output_state.preview_unavailable_reason: No artifact has been changed at intake.

confidence.basis: Task specification and asset manifest were read from the frozen V7 files.

remaining_work: Inspect sources, perform creative operations, render outputs, verify, and publish.

intent: Verify all 15 supplied files and inspect the garment/identity contact sheet.

rationale_summary.decision: Use the six actual garment photos, preserve color and construction, reject the damaged premade transparent logo.
rationale_summary.why: SHA-256 hashes match the task manifest, but the transparent master visibly fragments the leaf and lettering.

output_state.state_summary: Source identities and photograph colorways assessed.

Colorway carrier table names only Loopback Crew and Heavyweight Tee, with fabric inconsistencies for some rows.

confidence.basis: Direct source file inspection and exact hashes.

intent: Stage six source garment photographs and the original mark for Adobe processing.

rationale_summary.decision: Upload one batch to Creative Cloud.
rationale_summary.why: Adobe image tools require connector-accessible file handles.

tool_call.response_summary: 7 Creative Cloud asset IDs returned; no signed URLs retained in trajectory.

output_state.state_summary: Original mark and six garments are accessible to Adobe image tools.

confidence.basis: Connector returned seven successful asset records.

intent: Test Adobe auto tone on the pale crew and olive tee without changing their photographed colorway.

rationale_summary.decision: Retain the two toned versions; cloth and garment color remain recognizable.
rationale_summary.why: The pair provides a high/light and saturated-color stress test before batch treatment.

output_state.state_summary: Two tonal variants retained as intermediates.

confidence.basis: Side-by-side visual comparison; color shift appears slight but no calibrated physical swatch is present.

intent: Recover the supplied leaf and NORTHGROVE wordmark from the old printed page.

rationale_summary.decision: Use Adobe background cutout as layout source; retain SVG trace as evidence but do not place it because its background path is opaque.
rationale_summary.why: Premade transparent master is fragmented; Adobe cutout keeps wordmark shape and leaf intact.

tool_call.response_summary: Transparent PNG cutout and SVG trace returned

output_state.state_summary: Clean raster cutout selected; SVG vector trace rejected for placement due opaque background path.

issues_found: SVG trace includes a full-canvas background shape.

confidence.basis: Direct visual inspection of cutout and vector render, plus SVG geometry inspection.

intent: Apply the tested tonal treatment to the four remaining garments.

rationale_summary.decision: Retain all six Adobe-toned photos for the hybrid compositions.
rationale_summary.why: Contact sheet shows coherent light and no garment geometry changes.

output_state.state_summary: Four additional tonal variants retained as intermediates.

confidence.basis: Visual contact sheet review; no calibrated physical color reference.

intent: Compose six product modules and six launch carousel panels from Adobe-treated garments.

rationale_summary.decision: Use off-white editorial frames and the clean Adobe logo cutout; preserve image pixels and garment silhouettes.
rationale_summary.why: The client needs designed sale collateral, not just isolated photo edits.

output_state.state_summary: Twelve designed layouts ready for copy and visual inspection.

issues_found: Two carousel headings were not from approved source copy.

confidence.basis: Contact sheet inspection; full-size readability still to be checked.

intent: Replace two unapproved carousel slogans with named styles and supplied cloth specifications.

rationale_summary.decision: Use Tee / Raglan and Henley / Hoodie as headings; use exact 180 gsm and 340 gsm construction records.
rationale_summary.why: The brief calls for supplied approved copy and factual records.

output_state.state_summary: Final carousel uses named styles and approved material facts.

confidence.basis: Direct visual comparison of first and revised contact sheets.

intent: Inspect the 1440-pixel product module and 1080-pixel carousel at delivered size.

rationale_summary.decision: Correct a top rule intersecting the wordmark and use the regular rather than bold body-font face.
rationale_summary.why: The defect was not obvious in the small contact sheet; full-size inspection exposed it.
